sentences.text: 1 Despite service, there is no appearance on behalf of respondent no. 3, the Food Safety Commissioner for Gujarat & Commissioner, Food and Drugs Control Administration, Government of Gujarat.

entities.text: Food and Drugs Control Administration, Government of Gujarat
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Reason:

Court notice will be issued to the nominated/standing counsel for the State of Gujarat, who will obtain instructions and appear before this Court on the next date of hearing and file a counter affidavit/reply.

Respondent nos. 1 and 2, namely, Standard Review Cell Food Safety and Standard Authority of India, and FPO Western Region Food Safety and Standard Authority of India, have also not filed their counter affidavit/reply.

entities.text: Standard Review Cell Food Safety and Standard Authority of India
entities.label: RESPONDENT

entities.text: Western Region Food Safety and Standard Authority of India
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Ms. Swati Ghildiyal, the learned standing counsel for the State of Gujarat, entered appearance through video-conferencing and states that she has no instructions to appear in the present matter, but would take notice for respondent no.3.
A copy of the special leave petition shall be served by the learned counsel for the petitioner on the standing counsel for the State within one day.

In particular, we would like the respondents to respond to the question as to whether laboratories have the necessary equipment to undertake tests to ascertain as to whether the food products in the market are vegetarian or have non-vegetarian content.
Counter affidavit/reply shall be filed within four weeks from today.
Rejoinder affidavit, if any, may be filed within four weeks after service of the counter affidavit/reply.
Re -list in the week commencing 04.08.2025.

(BABITA PANDEY) (R.S. NARAYANAN)
